item.title: Coin Lockers and Where to Find Them
item.author: Unknown
item.description: Coin lockers are a near-ubiquitous oasis within Japanese cities and train stations for the multi-bag traveler.

item.title: Tax-Free Shopping and the Japan Trusted Travel Program (TTP)
item.author: Unknown
item.description: Japan lets foreigners shop tax free at lots of stores, using the QR-code entry visa stamp in their passport. What most stores don't know how to handle however, is a Japan Trusted Traveler Program card.
